description: ACTGOV Bridge Assets is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. This point dataset shows the locations of Bridges in the Australian Capital Territory. These assets are either owned or managed by City Services, City and Environment Directorate (CED). Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The portal files it under the category Infrastructure and Utilities. Its tags are structure, tccs, culvert, road infrastructure, transport. The table has 75 columns. Attribution on the portal: © Australian Capital Territory. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution | Share Alike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
